hero.lead: The city is growing — and everyone wants it for themselves. Buy businesses in six districts, take a role with its own powers and grab city projects before your rivals do.
hero.hook: And when the honest ways run out — dirt, rackets and shady deals. Just watch your scandals: pile up too many and you lose your role, or end up under arrest.
hero.pillarsLabel: What the game is made of
hero.districtsText: Buy buildings, strengthen your district and unlock unique bonuses that help you grow faster than everyone else.
hero.rolesText: Build your strategy around your role — or pick a different one when the situation calls for it. Roles can change hands during the game, and you can fight other players for them.
hero.projectsText: Take part in city projects to earn more victory points and bonuses that keep working for you until the end of the game.
hero.greyText: When the honest ways run out, go around them: smears, hacks and dirt score points, but every failure turns into a scandal.

about.title: A board game I am making myself
about.p1: Hi! City of Influence is my own board game. I make it in my free time, just because I love it. My dream is to see it one day as a real box on the table.
about.p2: and it will stay free: no ads and no paid advantages. Everyone plays on equal terms.
about.p3Start: If you like the game and want to help, you can support the project with any amount. All the money will go to
about.p3Strong: printing the first batch of the board game
about.p3End: : the cards, the board and the box.
about.p4: Your opinion means a lot to me. Found a bug, something is unclear, or you have an idea? Please write to me on the feedback page — I read every message.

feedback.title: Tell me what you think
feedback.lead: Here you can report a bug, share an idea or just tell me how you like the game. I read every message. Leave a contact and I will try to reply.
feedback.support: Like the project? You can support it — the money goes to printing the board game.
